intro.text: This entry describes acrofrontofacionasal dysostosis-3 (AFFND3). I do not reliably remember the causal gene or the reports that defined this form, so the molecular basis is not given here.

paragraphs.text: Acrofrontofacionasal dysostosis is a rare developmental disorder. It combines features of frontonasal dysplasia, such as hypertelorism and a broad or bifid nasal tip, with malformations of the hands and feet. Other features can include short stature and developmental delay or intellectual disability. AFFND3 is a genetically distinct form of the disorder. The specific reports and causal gene that define it are not given here because they could not be recalled with confidence.

paragraphs.text: Acrofrontofacionasal dysostosis is genetically heterogeneous. At least 2 other forms, AFFND1 and AFFND2, have been described.
